AccountDeleteRequest.description:
Self-service account deletion. `confirm_email` must equal the caller's own email — a
deliberate, hard-to-fumble confirmation so the destructive action can't fire by accident.
AccountDeleteRequest.title: AccountDeleteRequest

ActivityParticipantRead.description:
A row in an activity's roster. Activities are public, so this is just names/avatars —
no moderation. `is_creator` marks the organizer.
ActivityParticipantRead.title: ActivityParticipantRead

ActivityUpdate.description: Partial edit — only supplied fields change (creator-only).
ActivityUpdate.title: ActivityUpdate

AuthorCampusPostRead.description: Author-facing post including drafts (publish_at may be null).
AuthorCampusPostRead.title: AuthorCampusPostRead

JoinResult.description: `active` = joined an open group; `requested` = awaiting admin approval.
JoinResult.title: JoinResult

NotificationRead.description:
A single in-app notification. Structured (type + group + actor); the client renders the
sentence, so renamed groups/people always read correctly.
NotificationRead.title: NotificationRead

RecipientSearchResult.description: A lightweight, message-composer-facing user match (not the full profile).
RecipientSearchResult.title: RecipientSearchResult

StaffThreadCreate.description: Start (or resolve) a staff↔anyone conversation — no connection required.
StaffThreadCreate.title: StaffThreadCreate

StudentDirectoryEntry.description:
A student as seen by a staff member browsing the student directory — enough to recognise
and reach out, no matching signals. Staff-only surface (mirrors the staff directory).
StudentDirectoryEntry.title: StudentDirectoryEntry

UnreadSummary.description: Total unread + per-conversation counts (conversations with 0 unread are omitted).
UnreadSummary.title: UnreadSummary

delete.description:
Permanently delete the caller's account. Irreversible. `confirm_email` must match the
caller's own email. The account is anonymized in place — see the service for what is kept.
